# Viscous Cahn–Hilliard Forward Solver

This directory contains selected files from the [Sparse Optimal Control of Viscous Cahn–Hilliard Systems](https://github.com/Tejasvanvekar/Sparse-optimal-control-of-Viscous-Chan-hilliard-via-Gradient-descent--1D-2D) project. The two-dimensional forward solver is used by the dataset generation script.

The source version is recorded in `VCH_PINNED_SOURCE.json`. The original MIT license and copyright notice are retained in `LICENSE`.
